_readme: Curation for scripts/changelog.mjs, which turns `git log` into data/changelog.json (the Software Update app).
One update is one day of commits. Without an entry under `releases` a day gets its notes from the commit subjects themselves and a title built from them.
ignore:   regexes (case-insensitive) for commit subjects that say nothing to a visitor. A day whose commits are all ignored is left out of the list.
areas:    first match wins; gives an update its icon (`app` is an id from data/apps.yaml) and, when a day has several notes, its title.
releases: keyed by commit date (YYYY-MM-DD). `title`, `app` and `notes` each override the generated value; `hide: true` drops the day.
